name: A Second Home

angles.text: Newly risen Forsaken often feel adrift after breaking free from the Scourge. An order founded on community and shared faith offers a rare chance to rebuild.
Stronger ties among Forsaken in Tirisfal Glades help secure the Horde's presence in the northern Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.answer: Newly risen Forsaken are invited to join a new class order in Tirisfal Glades. They are directed to a monastery where like-minded practitioners can gather, find fellowship, and explore their shared potential.
faq.q: What is the quest A Second Home?

aliases: how to get to bandarion keep
faq.answer: Bandarion Keep stands on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead in Tirisfal Glades, beside the Whispering Woods.
faq.q: Where can Bandarion Keep be found?

faq.answer: Bandarion Keep is the monastery of Tyr's Watch, a Forsaken paladin order in Tirisfal Glades. It gathers newly risen brethren around community and shared faith.
faq.q: Who established the monastery at Bandarion Keep?

faq.answer: The founders believe newly risen undead can reach their full potential through community and shared purpose. Bandarion Keep offers their order a sanctuary and a place to learn.
faq.q: Why are the Forsaken being invited to Bandarion Keep?

faq.answer: The Solliden Farmstead lies in western Tirisfal Glades, southeast of the bluffs where Bandarion Keep overlooks the edge of the Whispering Woods.
faq.q: What is the connection to the Solliden Farmstead?

aliases: what order is at bandarion keep
faq.answer: Tyr's Watch is a newly formed Forsaken paladin order gathering at Bandarion Keep. It aims to support its kin as they adjust to their new unlife.
faq.q: What kind of order is gathering at Bandarion Keep?

sections.body: Newly risen Forsaken in Tirisfal Glades are urged to find fellowship among their peers. Together, they can face unlife through mutual faith and community, and discover their full potential.
sections.title: A Gathering of the Risen

sections.body: Travelers are directed to Bandarion Keep, a monastery on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead. Beside the Whispering Woods, it offers the new order a refuge to study, practice, and establish roots in Tirisfal.
sections.title: Sanctuary on the Bluffs

summary: Newly risen Forsaken are being invited to join an order in Tirisfal Glades. They are directed to Bandarion Keep, a monastery on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead near the Whispering Woods. The order offers community, shared faith, and mutual support as they make a place in their new unlife.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Second Home
